_comment: Statuses a unit can hold in a fight (fight/status/status_def.gd). Definitions only until S3 of the combat rework: no action applies one yet. effect: damage_taken_percent (the holder takes amount percent more damage). max_stacks: 1 means applying again only refreshes. expiry: holder_next_action (ends when the holder next acts) or never (ends only when consumed). consumed_by: hit (the next damage hit the holder takes), payoff (an action whose payoff_condition names it).
